name: Spinner
description: A fixed 20×20 indeterminate loading icon, with a flowing arc and no motion under reduced-motion preferences.

label.description: Accessible name when used alone; omit when the parent already announces loading.

title.description: Optional native pointer hint; also names the icon when label is absent.

must: Keep a 20×20 frame and inherit currentColor.
Use the same glyph inside Button loading and product loaders.
Remain static under system or application reduced motion.

notes: Without label the glyph is decorative. The parent owns pending announcements and aria-busy.

whenToUse: An operation is pending and its progress is unknown.

notes: The fixed 20px frame matches Icon. Its 1.625px line matches the 1.95px Iconoteka stroke scaled from 24px to 20px.
